name: Antigravity
description: Run Cindy tasks with the Google Antigravity CLI (agy) installed on this computer.
releaseNotes: Supports same-turn steering in remote and shared workspaces on Antigravity CLI 1.5.x, in addition to local tasks. Existing sign-in and custom agy paths are retained.

harnesses.name: Antigravity
harnesses.description: Runs tasks with the agy command-line agent installed on this computer, signed in with your Google account.

zh-CN.name: Antigravity
zh-CN.description: 使用本机安装、已用 Google 账号登录的 agy 命令行 Agent 运行任务。

author: MagicLizi, arnaudbrzh
whenToUse: Use when running Cindy tasks with Antigravity through the local agy CLI.
